rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a blog as a website or online journal.

example.english: I have a blog where I share cooking tips.
example.traditional: 我有個網誌，專門分享煮食心得。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 go3 mong5 zi3 zyun1 mun4 fan1 hoeng2 zyu2 sik6 sam1 dak1

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to an individual article or entry published on a blog.

example.english: This blog post already has over a thousand comments.
example.traditional: 呢篇網誌文章已經有過千個留言。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 mong5 zi3 man4 zoeng1 ji5 ging1 jau5 gwo3 cin1 go3 lau4 jin4
